title: Seat and control positioning
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on where seat or other controls are positioned, with one positive note about seat-control placement, negative comments about awkward reach or operation, and several fragments that broaden into other visibility or door-control placement issues.

positive.summary: The positive review says the current seat-control location is liked.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe seat or door-related controls as awkward to use because they require leaning forward or careful button holding.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention inconsistent seat-button behavior, hard-to-see control placement, accidental door-button activation, and leaning for visibility, but the sample is too varied to assign a single clear sentiment-based theme.

limitations: This cluster mixes seat controls with other subjects such as door controls, lighting-control placement, and outward visibility.
Several undetermined fragments do not clearly express a stable evaluative sentiment, which limits confidence in a narrower topic summary.
The examples are few and stratified, so they should not be treated as representative of all G70 feedback on controls or seating.
